call_date.title: Call Date
call_date.description: Date of the call; relative due dates resolve from it.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone of the call, if known.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: The due phrase exactly as spoken, such as 'by Friday'.

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: Calendar date resolved from call_date by code.

span_index.title: Span Index
span_index.description: Index into the job's analysis spans.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Keep the transcript and spans for up to 90 days to improve the labels.

FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest
FeedbackRequest.description: A vote on one span of a finished job. The label and the text come from the job record.

GatewayErrorResponse.title: GatewayErrorResponse
GatewayErrorResponse.description: What API Gateway sends when it answers instead of the app.

call_date.title: Call Date
call_date.description: Date of the call; relative due dates resolve from it.

speaker_names.title: Speaker Names
speaker_names.description: Names for the first and second voice heard; audio sources only.

JobRequest.title: JobRequest
JobRequest.description: Starts a job from exactly one source: an upload, a sample clip or a typed transcript.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id the request asked for.

served_by.title: Served By
served_by.description: Model that answered; differs after a refusal fallback.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Estimated cost; null when the model has no known price.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Model calls made: 2 after a validation retry.

dropped_quotes.title: Dropped Quotes
dropped_quotes.description: Spans dropped because the quote was not found.

turn_index.title: Turn Index
turn_index.description: Index of the transcript turn the quote comes from.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who is bound to act: a speaker id or a named person.

action.title: Action
action.description: Short verb phrase, such as 'send revised pricing'.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The stated condition; required for CONDITIONAL.

in_ledger.title: In Ledger
in_ledger.description: COMMITMENT, HEDGED and CONDITIONAL create a ledger entry.

soft.title: Soft
soft.description: HEDGED entries are stored in the ledger marked soft.

text.title: Text
text.description: What the speaker said in this turn.

start_ms.title: Start Ms
start_ms.description: Start of the turn in the audio; set for audio jobs.

end_ms.title: End Ms
end_ms.description: End of the turn in the audio; set for audio jobs.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Form fields to send before the file, unchanged.

max_bytes.title: Max Bytes
max_bytes.description: Largest accepted file; 60 s of 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description: A presigned S3 POST: send `fields`, then the file as the last form field, to `url`.

SitePassword.name: Authorization
SitePassword.description: The site password, sent as the whole Authorization header value.
